narrationScript: Welcome to Chapter 1.6: Benchmarking and Workload Characterization. In computer architecture, evaluating performance is crucial for design decisions. This chapter will equip you with the knowledge to assess processor performance accurately. By the end of this lesson, you will be able to describe the SPEC CPU benchmark suite and its methodology, understand the importance of representative workloads in architecture evaluation, analyze various workload characteristics like instruction mix and cache behavior, and finally, evaluate the strengths and limitations of synthetic versus real-world benchmarks. Let's begin our exploration into how we quantitatively measure and understand processor performance.
